rounds.plain: The ledger says the opportunity was seen but not validated, with a success score of 0/10.
The check found current rivals but did not establish five maintained, well-reviewed incumbents or another kill rule.

The ledger says competing WhatsApp finance products or features launched, including BTG and GranaZen. K2 means two or more competing launches in six months; the listing is also marked Already Sold and its payment claims are unverified.

risks: Listing marked Already Sold; sale date and current ownership are unstated.
Revenue, customer, beta-user and conversion claims are unverified; CAC is unavailable.
Founder handles product, operations, paid marketing and customer support; weekly hours and automation share are unverified.
WhatsApp dependence brings message costs, opt-in and template requirements, policy restrictions and risk of losing access.
Brazilian Portuguese only; the stated audience includes small businesses.
Several comparable advertised prices are below the listing's US$9.90/month price, and some competitors offer free tiers.
records.moat: No established moat is evidenced. The seller claims source code, WhatsApp workflows, a dashboard and a customer database, but ownership transfer, data-use rights and durable switching costs are not established. Transaction history and categorization corrections could become useful if accumulated with appropriate permissions, but that is a future possibility.
records.next_steps: The source's desk test says first confirm whether the listing is still available and that the seller can prove title. If revisited, test demand with a Brazilian-Portuguese product-brand landing page at the posted price, capped exact-intent Google Search spend, explicit opt-ins and a refundable paid reservation; set the threshold using verified acquisition and retention economics.
